message:
FULL BRIEF - you are QA agent qa3 for the Cinder Typhoon scenario (repo /home/atomik/src/shifter-scenarios). You have no prior context; this is your complete brief.

SCOPE: KeplerOps/FieldLink cards K16.1 through K31.x on range host cinder-rs2-keplerops, starting at K16.1. Skip K26.2, K26.3, K27.3 (another agent covers them).

ACCESS: gcloud compute ssh cinder-rs2-keplerops --project prod-mgau4w --zone us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap (gcloud is in /snap/bin; always pass --project prod-mgau4w). Participant surface: sudo docker exec -it --user rowan cinder-keplerops-k-dev bash . The k-dev container as user rowan is the participant workstation; use participant tools (CLI, curl as the browser, git, kubectl with rowan's kubeconfig) against *.keplerops.test service names.

GOAL: prove each card works as designed, exercised as a real participant would. This is NOT a test of whether you can solve it. Do not explore or work out solutions; follow the documented happy path.

HAPPY-PATH SOURCES (read BEFORE you touch the range, every card):
1. Design doc: cinder-typhoon/docs/design/challenges/<ARC>/<ID>.md (for example K16/K16.1.md, W18/W18.1.md). K cards: sections 'Prerequisites and starting position', 'Vulnerability and intended solution', 'Evidence and completion'. W cards: 'Starting position', 'Native surface and normal behavior', 'Completion and product evidence'.
2. Scripted known solutions (exact requests and expected values; grep the card ID):
   - K: cinder-typhoon/build/keplerops/tests/test_known_solution_live.py and test_k04/k09/k11/k28_live.py
   - W: cinder-typhoon/build/arwc/tests/test_known_solution_live.py and test_wNN_live.py; OT cards also cinder-typhoon/build/arwc-ot/challenges/<ARC>/
3. Hints: cinder-typhoon/build/card-coverage/hints-*.yaml
Tests sometimes use operator helpers (docker exec, operator files). Take only the participant-facing requests and expected values, and run them from the participant surface. If test and design doc disagree, follow the design doc.

HARD RULE - participant surfaces only: no docker exec into any container other than the participant surface below, no host filesystem, /opt source, or .operator material, no host root except to enter the participant surface. A card reachable only through a backdoor is a fail.

EXECUTION: run the documented path exactly. If a step does not work, do not search for another way: report fail at once with the exact command and actual response, then move on. If a card is not resolved in 10 minutes, report it and move on. Single-use steps: save response bodies to files (curl -o) before parsing; if you burn one, post a blocker and continue.

WALKTHROUGH (passing cards only): write cinder-typhoon/docs/qa/walkthroughs/<ARC>/<ID>.md . It is only the commands, in order, that solve the card: step 0 is the gcloud ssh and docker exec lines, then one fenced code block per command with the real values filled in (no placeholders), each with a short note of the output value the next command uses, ending with the acceptance check and its output. No other sections. Do not edit any other repo file.

REPORTING (append to THIS file, a JSON array; never delete entries): {"from":"qa3","to":"overseer","timestamp":"<UTC ISO8601>","type":"result|blocker|status","card":"<ID>","verdict":"pass|fail","detail":"short; for pass, the walkthrough path; for fail, the exact command and response"}
Post a status message when you come online. Keep polling this file for overseer replies; when I post that a failed card is fixed, re-run it.

- Your card's flag value is in /home/atomik/src/shifter-scenarios/cinder-typhoon/flags/placement.yaml (flag_id = card ID). Read it; do not edit it.

- The flag must not be reachable without completing the card (not in normal responses, other files, or before the gate). It must be the same on every range: hardcode it in the scenario source or seeded content, never generate it at boot.
